Published crate: msb_krun 0.1.39, SHA256 `0944407a6ae125935e64dcf9be666e56d2cca0907b9e34be6648784db453490c`; originating libkrun revision `2bd0f84ad0956f3032e0490d3b8512b6851eca12`. License: Apache-2.0 (`LICENSE`).

WI 0119 adds a typed, once-per-process `EmbeddedKernel` registry. The loader selects registered bytes only when its internal firmware path resolves to this executable or the internal `@embedded-kernel` marker; all other paths keep the published DSO behavior. The SDK still requires a real firmware path, so the executable path is internal transport until WI 0120 supplies an embedded origin. The kernel pointer is backed by static bytes for the process lifetime; the caller validates architecture, checksum, bounds and addresses before registration. This patch has no exported C symbol and does not use process symbol lookup.

`Cargo.toml.orig` is the published source manifest. `upstream.diff` applies to the published crate with `patch -p1`. Replace/remove this patch when WI 0120 adopts an upstream kernel-provider API (upstream `msb_krun 0.1.40`+ ships the opt-in `static-krunfw` feature, libkrun #144) and equivalent release builds pass.

**Verification status:** this typed registry loader booted actual awman guests natively on Apple Silicon (WI 0122) and passed WI 0123's hardware, clean-checkout and signed-artifact tiers. Linux is unbooted: the only Linux ARM64 run stopped at `/dev/kvm` `ENOENT`, and x86_64 has not run; both are WI 0124 gates. The strict-embed spike patch (`tools/oci-runtime-spike/strict-embed/embedded-loader.patch`) is historical evidence only. On x86_64 Linux the VMM maps the registered bytes directly as guest RAM, and on macOS Mach-O does not honour the static's 64 KiB alignment, so on those targets awman registers a writable, 64 KiB-aligned heap copy rather than the read-only static (`crates/awman-host-shims/src/kernel.rs`).
